title: Followed by a 12-year-old tall white girl on the walk back to the Nellis barracks
summary: Charles Hall tells of Followed by a 12-year-old tall white girl on the walk back to the Nellis barracks, about 1965 at Nellis AFB, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he served at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada in the 1960s, tells of beings he calls the tall whites, very tall, pale non-human people he says lived near the base's test ranges. He says that in 1965, as he walked back to his barracks, a tall white girl he describes as about 12 years old followed him, which, if true, would mean these beings had families living alongside the military.
